DOCUMENTATION.description: The issue asks for, reports a problem with, or proposes a change to documentation: docs pages, READMEs, guides, tutorials, API references, code examples or docstrings.
do_not_mark: a bug or feature request that only mentions the docs in passing, e.g. "the docs say this should work, but it crashes"
tools that generate documentation, e.g. a bug in a docs build plugin, unless the issue is about the resulting docs

examples.text: README install instructions are out of date
examples.label: DOCUMENTATION
